ecobite.name: EcoBite
ecobite.description: API and developer portal for a sustainable food-delivery platform.

sections.title: The platform
sections.text: EcoBite connects customers with eco-friendly restaurants. I build the backend: a REST API for restaurants, delivery zones, accounts, and orders, where the server calculates each order's total, packaging, and CO₂ saved.

sections.title: The approach
sections.text: Express 5 and TypeScript over PostgreSQL with Prisma. An OpenAPI 3.1 contract, rendered with Scalar, is what the frontend builds against, and every release is documented in a public changelog.

sections.title: The outcome
sections.text: Versioned releases up to v1.2.0, with rate-limited authentication, admin roles checked against the database on every request, a health check, and graceful shutdown.

personal-portfolio.name: Personal portfolio
personal-portfolio.description: A home for my work, writing, and the things I learn along the way.

sections.title: A place for the work
sections.text: This website brings projects, experience, and writing together in a quiet, readable space. The two-rail layout keeps recent writing close by while leaving the main column focused on the page you are reading.

sections.title: Built to stay simple
sections.text: Pages render on the server, while small interactive components handle navigation state and filtering. Profile information, projects, and posts live in typed data modules, separate from the presentation.

sections.title: Room to grow
sections.text: The writing section supports individual articles and an optional list of external publications. Content can move to a CMS later without redesigning the reading experience.

poxyram.name: Poxyram
poxyram.description: Backend platform and API for Poxyram Studio.

sections.title: The platform
sections.text: Poxyram Studio needed a backend that could handle their platform operations end to end. I built the API from the ground up, covering data models, authentication, and the services their frontend depends on.

sections.title: The approach
sections.text: The backend is structured around clear service boundaries with typed contracts between layers. Every endpoint is documented and tested, and the database schema is versioned so migrations are predictable.

sections.title: The outcome
sections.text: The API is live and serving the platform. It handles the day-to-day operations of Poxyram Studio and is built to grow as the product does.

sections.title: The store
sections.text: An online store built for Luisardito. The frontend is fast, accessible, and easy to manage, with a checkout flow that stays out of the way.

sections.title: The approach
sections.text: Built with Next.js and TypeScript. Pages are server-rendered for speed and SEO, with client-side interactivity only where it is needed.

sections.title: The outcome
sections.text: The store is live and serving customers. It is designed to grow with the catalog without needing a rebuild.
